This site summarizes the BFD fungal genome database across the main functional areas. Every figure uses **one representative genome per species** (best BUSCO complete, then N50; annotated genomes only) and groups genomes by phylum, with the eight largest phyla shown separately and the rest pooled as "Other". Group values are medians or means **over genomes**, never over proteins, so large genomes do not dominate.

These pages describe the database; they do not test hypotheses. For tested hypotheses with effect sizes and caveats see the [summary atlas](../summary_atlas/index.md) and [FUNCTIONAL_ANALYSES](../FUNCTIONAL_ANALYSES.md).

## Phylum overview
